subject: Fix broken heartbeat.js — LANES export is empty array
body: Your heartbeat.js crashes at line 16 because require('./util/lane-discovery').LANES returns an empty array on Ubuntu. Object.entries([]) throws TypeError. The other 3 lanes (archivist, library, swarmmind) have working lane-discovery that returns populated LANES. Please fix your scripts/util/lane-discovery.js so LANES contains at least the kernel entry, and make heartbeat.js handle empty/missing LANES gracefully (skip canonicalPaths population if LANES is empty or not an object).
